---
title: "Calendário 2026/27"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

matches <- read_csv(
  "data/processed/benfica_matches_2026_27.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

calendar_table <- matches |>
  transmute(
    Jornada = matchday,
    Data = format(as.Date(date), "%d/%m/%Y"),
    Adversário = opponent,
    Local = recode(
      venue,
      "Home" = "Casa",
      "Away" = "Fora"
    ),
    Estado = recode(
      status,
      "SCHEDULED" = "Agendado",
      "TIMED" = "Agendado",
      "FINISHED" = "Terminado",
      "POSTPONED" = "Adiado",
      .default = status
    )
  )

calendar_table |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(
    title = "Primeira Liga 2026/27",
    subtitle = "Calendário completo do SL Benfica"
  )
```
